title: Introduce delta artifact signing + rollback-plan generator for private-installer releases
author: Ava Martinez
description: Motivation: Private deployments need predictable, auditable updates and safe rollback paths for clusters that cannot reach our hosted control plane. This PR adds a compact delta artifact signing flow and an automated rollback-plan generator that: 1) produces per-release delta bundles (tar.gz deltas + provenance metadata), 2) signs delta manifests with our KMS-backed signing key, 3) generates a machine-readable rollback plan (instructions + required artifacts) for every release bundle, and 4) exposes Terraform-friendly outputs so on-prem upgrade orchestrators can fetch verified deltas and apply rollbacks without live API access. This is intended to reduce bandwidth for upgrades, accelerate patch creation, and give operators clear, auditable rollback instructions.
commits_summary: 5 commits: (1) build: add delta bundler and provenance schema; (2) security: integrate KMS signing helper and rotation hooks; (3) tooling: rollback-plan generator and YAML schema; (4) terraform: exports to module outputs + example usage; (5) tests: add CI validations and e2e smoke for apply/rollback flow.

release_notes:
- Added delta artifacts: smaller patches for private-installer upgrades.
- Signed delta manifests (KMS-backed).
- Automatic rollback-plan generator that produces a machine-readable YAML plan per release.
- Terraform module outputs for delta/rollback URLs to integrate with on-prem orchestrators.
- New CI pipeline stage to build, sign, and publish delta bundles.
testing_notes: Unit tests: signer, proto serialization, generator logic. Integration: mocked registry tests for publish/verify. E2E smoke: KinD cluster apply and stepwise rollback using generated rollback-plan.yaml. Manual validation steps included in docs/priv-installer/release-deltas.md.
upgrade_and_rollback_instructions: Operator flow (summary): 1) Download release bundle + delta_manifest.json and rollback-plan.yaml from the artifact registry URL exported by Terraform. 2) Verify signatures with provided public key (cosign or built-in verifier). 3) Apply delta in 'staged' mode and run health probes. 4) If probe fails, run rollback-plan steps in order (plan includes exact artifact URLs and preflight commands). 5) For emergency offline rollback, apply artifacts from signed offline mirror following the same verification steps.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: operators may accidentally apply an incompatible delta. Mitigation: delta bundler emits a compatibility matrix and verifier refuses mismatched release_version or incompatible-kernel markers; CI also runs cross-version smoke tests. Risk: signing key compromise. Mitigation: rotation hooks, limited-scope signer role, and short-lived credentials documented.
